author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: ARK Electronics has recently featured the ARK Just A Pi, a compact carrier board for the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5. The board provides USB, Ethernet, CSI camera, UART, PCIe, HDMI, and GPIO connectivity in a small form factor intended for integration with autopilot and embedded systems. title: ARK Just A Pi carrier board links Raspberry Pi CM5 to autopilot systems
